limitations: Raw branch token arrays plus enqueue source establish the prompt constructed/submitted by this code, but no independent vLLM request-level token dump or KV cache snapshot was saved.
This CPU audit cannot conclusively rule out an internal vLLM attention/KV cache fault; doing so requires controlled cache-on/off same-input GPU comparison after the current frozen run.
Identical token length is not identical response content; response text, token arrays, seeds, evolving board observations and logprobs were checked directly.

teacher_forcing_audit.scope: 11 selected shortest/longest/shared-prefix training trajectories; source pack executed on CPU with only its device literal changed in memory

sampling_logprob_semantics.interpretation: Saved evaluation logprobs are probabilities after the evaluation sampling transforms; a sole surviving candidate has exactly logprob 0 and is unaffected by a different seed. They are not raw unfiltered model probabilities.

conclusion_zh: 未发现应用层漏加观测、历史丢失、seed复用或teacher-forcing上下文错位。响应同长主要来自固定模板、反复撞墙/方向循环，以及单轮token死循环。没有独立KV缓存快照或cache-off GPU对照，不能据CPU审计完全排除vLLM内部缓存/注意力问题。

training_sampling.vocabulary: All model output IDs for GRPO/PaTR/Tree/DAPO; corrected ARPO uses tokenizer IDs, with the same mask in actor and reference normalization.
training_sampling.probability_semantics: No temperature rescaling or top-p/top-k truncation beyond explicit ARPO vocabulary policy; HF/vLLM arithmetic differences are covered by separate numerical diagnostics.

validation_sampling.probability_semantics: Saved logprobs refer to the transformed sampling distribution. Do not treat as unfiltered model entropy or use directly for HF training-policy KL comparisons.

training_update_dataflow.main: train.main collect(...,evaluation=False by default), then update; evaluate uses local branches and returns only metrics.
training_update_dataflow.method_probe: sample_batch collect(...,evaluation=False) feeds update and disposable fixed-batch replay; validation branches never enter optimizer.
training_update_dataflow.importance_correction: train.update uses the frozen teacher-forced training-policy anchor minus saved training sampling logprobs on the same assistant targets; correction clamped at 2 in behavior variant.
training_update_dataflow.result: No validation-decoding logprobs were found entering current optimizer or IS calculation.

numerical_probe_initial.measured_branches: first 8 returned branches from 4 validation tasks x 8 branches
numerical_probe_initial.interpretation: Validation task identity does not mean evaluation decoding. This diagnostic compares training-mode sampling logprobs to HF on the same contexts, not filtered evaluation logprobs.

gradient_probe.input: v1 formal PaTR training rollouts_0200.jsonl.gz, first two trajectories with sequence length<=2500
gradient_probe.modified_rewards: synthetic alternating 0/1 for nonzero gradient coverage
gradient_probe.interpretation: A fixed-context gradient/update engineering regression, not an outcome improvement experiment or a fresh initial-policy logprob calibration. Its off-policy historical logprobs must not be interpreted as fresh initial sampling mismatch.

assessment_zh: 应用层上下文、mask、teacher-forcing target对齐检查通过；尚未观察到实现缺陷。重复文本符合当前解码分布与模型循环行为；内部KV缓存是否完全无误仍需要独立cache-off对照才能彻底排除，不在本次只读CPU审计范围。
